ANIMAGLAJZ – animations from Sutnarka

11. 20. 2026
7 PM – 8:30 PM

After a long while, another Czech art school is presenting its animated work at Kasárna, this time Sutnarka from Pilsen. Formally known as the Ladislav Sutnar Faculty of Design and Art, the school encourages its students to find a distinctive authorial voice, not only in the short film but also in the music video, animated documentary, visual poem, moving object, video game, fine-art projection installation and many other media. 

The screening program will show a wide range of visual, narrative and media languages, from mischievous, quirky gags and delicate, lyrical video collages to subversive video reports. In short, an animated mishmash just as it should be! Besides the films and videos, there will be Pilsner on tap at the bar, fittingly for the theme, and you’ll be able to chat with some of our students about their work or anything else.

Admission: 100 CZK
